verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented API for programmatic session creation/automation (devin-docs-7, devin-docs-8), a CLI for local/headless agent use with sandboxing (devin-docs-4, devin-docs-12), and explicit CI/CD integration guidance for responding to static analysis findings and iterating on CI failures (devin-docs-18, devin-docs-19), all supporting headless/automated operation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CI usage specifically, and no third-party confirmation of headless reliability at scale.
